entities.name: Site historique maritime de la Pointe-au-Père
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Site historique maritime de la Pointe-au-Père is a maritime museum located in Rimouski, Quebec, Canada, that displays 200 years of maritime history, and includes the first submarine open since 2009 to the public in Canada, HMCS Onondaga.
